name: Design Property and Fuzz Tests
summary: Translate stable invariants and threat boundaries into reproducible property-based and fuzz tests.
description: Design property-based or fuzz testing from observable invariants, input models, shrinking, reproducible seeds, budgets, and failure triage. Use when example tests miss broad input spaces, parser boundaries, state transitions, or adversarial inputs.
risk_reason: This skill translates stable invariants and threat boundaries into reproducible property-based and fuzz tests; it does not execute unbounded fuzz campaigns or target production and shared services.
refuses: It does not execute unbounded fuzz campaigns or target production and shared services.
It does not treat random input volume, code coverage, or a run without crashes as proof of correctness or security.
It does not retain sensitive generated samples, secrets, or user data in seeds and corpora.

operational.latency_reason: The skill translates stable invariants and threat boundaries into reproducible property-based and fuzz tests, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
